AP620 RGB Light — APKINA

A 24W RGB light with app control, adjustable barndoors, an OLED display and 18W fast charging.

SPECIFICATIONS
Power: 24W
CRI: Ra ≥95
Colour temperature: 2500–9900K
RGB: 360° HSI (36000)
Lighting effects: 24
Intensity: 1–100%
Battery: 7.4V / 5200mAh (38Wh)
Battery life: 1.65–12 hours, at maximum–minimum power
Charging time: 2.5 hours with 18W fast charging
Input: Type-C 5V/2A; 9V/2A (18W maximum)
PD/QC fast charge: 18W maximum
App control: Supported
Illuminance at 0.3m: 12,700 lux at 9900K
Illuminance at 1m: 1,750 lux at 9900K
LED beads: 72
Beam angle: 45°
Display: OLED
Shell material: Aluminium alloy + ABS grip + PC
Barndoors: ABS; 120° adjustable
Net weight: 845g
Dimensions: 605 × 101 × 47.3mm, barndoors folded
